name: FFS_DBM_STEP_RUN
description: DB Maintenance: Used to store a state of the currently executed task steps as well as log records. This data is also used to resume long running tasks on restart of the service.

columns.name: STEP_RUN_ID
columns.description: Step run id. generated by sequence.

columns.name: TASK_RUN_ID
columns.description: Task run id. FK reference to DBM_TASK_RUN.

columns.name: STEP_LABEL
columns.description: Step name. List of steps is task specific and is supported in MS code.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Contains status of the task step. Possible values: created, in_progress, completed, failed, suspended.

columns.name: STARTED_AT
columns.description: Contains start time of the task step run.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Contains duration of the task step run, sec.

columns.name: RUN_INFO
columns.description: Contains additional step run information. Optional, in json format.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
